verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a marketing line about exporting consolidated expense data into accounting systems, which suggests some export capability but says nothing about exporting all account/card/transaction data, the format used, or a full offboarding/data-portability guarantee. Missing for 10: confirmation of open/standard export formats (CSV/JSON), completeness of exportable data (cards, transactions, disputes, KYC data), and any documented account-closure/data-portability process.
